name: Google
jd_text: Software Engineer, Early Career. Responsibilities: Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance large-scale distributed software solutions. Requirements: Strong proficiency in Data Structures and Algorithms, advanced Graph algorithms (Dijkstra, BFS/DFS, Topological Sort), Dynamic Programming optimizations, Tree traversals, concurrency, multi-threading, clean code in C++, Java, or Python, and deep understanding of Operating Systems and Computer Networks.

name: Amazon
jd_text: Software Development Engineer I (SDE-1). Responsibilities: Build highly scalable, fault-tolerant customer-facing cloud microservices using AWS. Requirements: Mastery in Object-Oriented Design, data structures, Trees (Binary Search Trees, Trie), Graphs, Dynamic Programming, Heaps, Priority Queues, database indexing, RESTful APIs, and Amazon Leadership Principles including Customer Obsession and Ownership.

name: Microsoft
jd_text: Software Engineer - Azure and Cloud Platforms. Responsibilities: Architect reliable, globally distributed cloud infrastructure services. Requirements: Strong algorithmic fundamentals, problem-solving in Linked Lists, Trees, Graph theory, Dynamic Programming, String algorithms, Operating Systems (Memory Management, Virtual Memory, Process Concurrency), and Low-Level Object Oriented Design.

name: Adobe
jd_text: Member of Technical Staff - Creative Cloud Engineering. Responsibilities: High-performance graphics rendering, digital media pipelines, and full-stack cloud workflows. Requirements: High problem-solving speed in algorithmic puzzles, Dynamic Programming, complex geometry/math, Bit Manipulation, Arrays, OS threading, and memory optimization in C++ or modern web technologies.

name: Oracle
jd_text: Applications Engineer / Database Cloud Engineer. Responsibilities: Develop enterprise cloud applications, database query optimizers, and automated data pipelines. Requirements: Advanced SQL, Relational Database Management Systems (DBMS, ACID, B-Trees, Normalization), concurrency, Hash Tables, Tree traversals, and Java enterprise development.

name: Cisco
jd_text: Network Software Engineer. Responsibilities: Build next-generation routing, switching, and cloud network telemetry software. Requirements: Deep understanding of Computer Networks (OSI, TCP/IP, Routing Protocols, DNS, Subnetting), Socket Programming, OS Deadlocks and Inter-Process Communication, and Graph algorithms.

name: Morgan Stanley
jd_text: Technology Analyst - Enterprise Institutional Securities. Responsibilities: Design ultra-low-latency financial trading platforms and real-time risk assessment engines. Requirements: Solid OOP and Design Patterns, multithreading, concurrency, Dynamic Programming, relational databases, data structures, and financial aptitude.

name: Goldman Sachs
jd_text: Engineering Analyst - Core Strats & Global Markets. Responsibilities: Quantitative modeling, algorithmic trading systems, and mission-critical financial software. Requirements: High mathematical ability, probability and statistics, Dynamic Programming, string algorithms, computational complexity, and clean modular code.

name: TCS
jd_text: TCS Digital / Ninja Engineer. Responsibilities: Develop business enterprise applications, digital transformation initiatives, and cloud modernization. Requirements: Strong Quantitative and Logical Aptitude, core programming skills in Java/Python/C, basic Data Structures (Arrays, Strings, Stacks, Queues), SQL queries, and fundamental OOP concepts.

name: Infosys
jd_text: Specialist Programmer / Digital Specialist Engineer. Responsibilities: Build scalable enterprise solutions and modernize client IT estates. Requirements: Aptitude and logical reasoning, fundamentals of programming, basic Arrays, recursion, String manipulation, DBMS concepts, and clean coding standards.

name: Cognizant
jd_text: GenC Elevate / Next Engineer. Responsibilities: Enterprise software development, QA automation, and cloud migration support. Requirements: Aptitude and verbal proficiency, basic algorithmic problem solving, Object Oriented Programming, and basic Database queries.

name: Wipro
jd_text: Wipro Elite National Talent Hunt - Project Engineer. Responsibilities: Support software engineering lifecycle, agile software deliveries, and technology maintenance. Requirements: Analytical and logical aptitude, basic coding proficiency, understanding of loops, conditionals, arrays, and standard OOP principles.

name: Accenture
jd_text: Associate Software Engineer (ASE) / Advanced ASE. Responsibilities: Develop, test, and implement technology solutions across global clients. Requirements: Strong analytical and quantitative problem solving, critical thinking, fundamental coding skills, understanding of cloud computing basics, and verbal communication.
